name: OCGIS Parcels
license: OC Survey / OCGIS public data; terms of use on ocgis.com
how_used: Defines the parcels. APN, address and year built come from here; lot size, frontage and buildable area are computed from the polygon.
notes: Fields: OBJECTID, SITE_ADDRESS, ASSESSMENT_NO (APN), YEAR_BUILT, NBR_BEDROOMS. No use code, assessed value or owner name. See docs/describe_layer_report.md.

name: OCGIS City Boundaries
license: OC Survey / OCGIS public data; terms of use on ocgis.com
how_used: Tags each parcel with the city containing its interior point; flags parcels split by a city line.
notes: Fields JURISDICTI, CITY. Areas outside every polygon are tagged Unincorporated.

name: OCGIS Unincorporated Area
license: OC Survey / OCGIS public data; terms of use on ocgis.com
how_used: With city boundaries, defines the county footprint used to reject non-OC ZIPs.
notes: With city boundaries, defines the county footprint used to validate OC ZIPs.

name: Census 2020 ZCTA (TIGERweb)
license: Public domain (U.S. Government work)
how_used: The ZIP polygon. A parcel belongs to the ZIP containing its interior point.
notes: Layer 7 = Census 2020 ZCTAs. Field GEOID = 5-digit ZCTA.

name: Census tracts (TIGERweb)
license: Public domain (U.S. Government work)
how_used: Gives each parcel a tract GEOID for the ACS, LODES and Opportunity Zone joins.
notes: Tract GEOID used to join ACS, LODES, Opportunity Zones. Confirm layer 0 is tracts.

name: OCGIS Building Footprints
license: OC Survey / OCGIS public data; terms of use on ocgis.com
how_used: Footprint area inside the parcel ÷ lot area = building coverage; no footprint = vacant.
notes: Default footprint source because it is bbox-queryable. Overture/Microsoft are file alternatives (set FOOTPRINT_SOURCE).

name: Overture Maps buildings
license: ODbL 1.0 (buildings theme)
refresh_date: Monthly Overture release; record release id at ingest
how_used: Alternative footprint source (set FOOTPRINT_SOURCE=overture_buildings).

name: OCGIS Street Centerlines
license: OC Survey / OCGIS public data; terms of use on ocgis.com
how_used: Frontage = parcel edge within 60 ft of a centerline.
notes: Used for frontage. If unavailable, frontage falls back to the short side of the parcel's minimum rotated rectangle (flagged frontage_method=mrr_estimate).

name: SCAG High Quality Transit Corridors, base year 2022 (half-mile buffer)
license: SCAG Open Data terms of use
refresh_date: Connect SoCal 2024 base year 2022 (SCAG updates every 4 years)
how_used: Parcel gets `in_hqta` = true if it overlaps any feature.
notes: Queried live from SCAG. The layer is the corridor lines; the engine buffers them half a mile (2,640 ft) to approximate the High Quality Transit Area. Half-mile areas around major rail and BRT stops are not in this layer, so HQTA can be undercounted near stations. Do not use the RTP2020 layers.
